summary: The implementation successfully addresses all major requirements. The website includes all required sections (hero, products, process, health benefits, contact), implements backend inquiry submission, features responsive navigation with smooth scrolling, applies the natural kraft paper aesthetic with appropriate color scheme and typography, and displays 180ml bottle specifications throughout. All seven requirements (REQ-1 through REQ-7) are implemented with their acceptance criteria met.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin functionality for managing inquiries (updateInquiryStatus, getAllInquiries, getInquiryById, getInquirysByStatus)
hallucinated_features.reason: The backend includes inquiry management endpoints that were not requested in the BuildRequest. The requirement REQ-5 only specified storing inquiry submissions and providing confirmation feedback, not admin management capabilities.
The implementation includes complete Internet Identity integration with hooks and providers, but authentication/login was explicitly listed as a non-goal in the BuildRequest.
Both CSS files include comprehensive dark mode theming, but dark mode was not mentioned in the requirements or design specifications.

hallucinated_features.description: Caffeine.ai attribution in footer with UTM tracking
hallucinated_features.reason: Footer includes specific attribution to caffeine.ai with window.location-based UTM tracking, which was not requested in the BuildRequest.
